Subject: Denver office moving to 1550 Wazee Street on October 1

Hi team,

Our Denver office will move to 1550 Wazee Street on October 1.

The new space has two fewer floors, which lowers our costs and encourages closer collaboration. It also has a dedicated, secure bike room. Desks will be booked through an app, so you can plan your in-office days and reserve a spot that suits your work.

Facilities will share packing guidelines, move-day logistics, and instructions for the booking app in the coming weeks. Please start sorting and clearing out personal items from your current workspace.

If you have questions or accessibility needs, contact the Facilities team at any time. We'll keep you updated as the move approaches.

Thank you for your flexibility.

Best,
